# PhyloGuessr

## Autogenerated Files

**`public/taxonomy/easy-scenarios.json` — DO NOT EDIT DIRECTLY**

This file is autogenerated by `scripts/build-easy-scenarios.mjs`, which
concatenates individual scenario files from the `scenarios/` directory. The
source of truth is the scenario files, not this bundle.

Each scenario file sets `"difficulty"` to `"easy"` (all three species are
recognizable names) or `"tricky"` (obscure species or surprising relatives). The
`/easy` and `/tricky` modes each play their own difficulty.

To modify scenarios:

1. Edit individual files in `scenarios/` directory
2. Run `pnpm build-easy-scenarios` to regenerate the bundle
3. Or run `pnpm update-data` which rebuilds everything
